tile.content: ot_s81hd_tile = 1 bundle (4 A + 1 B elements as CLOSED hard cores) + chain glue
tile.cells_basis: 4 x elemA 214445 (ASSUMED: elemB cells x area ratio (no elemA count committed)) + elemB 163817 + glue 50000 ASSUMED
tile.hard_cores: 5 (each < 400k cells): the tile is over the 400k CORE-KS cap, so the elements are its cores
tile.chain_bus: bus B: x 512 (xa K0..4095 / xb K4096..5119) + go + xv + rv + row17 + bits32 (FP32 logit) + flt

face_pins.note: +1 epoch bit; on a 345.6-um window with M4+M6 = 1.6 pins/um

serdes.note: same slot, PHY abstract and bump field as the S81 layer die (cross-die die_io pairing)

link_row.note: one row of layer-die frames inside each SerDes row: link endpoints, ctl, ft stations

spine.note: one spine node a row-pair: x/go down, best up, W/E chain heads (upper row) and tails (lower)

tiles.fanout: none: x enters a chain head once and is forwarded tile to tile (registered); best is merged forward; no mux/demux beyond the 3-way spine node copy

spine.content: spo (x/go 3-way registered forward) + spr (capture-all-then-fire argmax) per level

ctl.cells_basis: ASSUMED (SPEC ctl ~1.5 x 1.5 mm; x store 80 kb SRAM)
ctl.content: x store + stream issue + spine root + final compare + rank merge + dsfd_mtp_seq + token former + host frame mux + fault/status

lep_0N.content: dsdv_slice_lepw_mu.LP (the layer die's s_0N_LP: identical stage-circuit protocol)
lep_0N.cells_basis: layer die cells_est s_0N_LP (measured lep + lanes, flattened)

mesh_ep.cells_basis: ASSUMED (layer die 2-lane lep LP 192k incl. MU land)

blocks.hbm: none: the LM head is ROM-resident and argmax/MTP state is small; the rack's 4 stacks a head die (10-06 record) is not needed by this die: OWNER decision (saves 48 stacks)

stage_out.payload: token (+ in-band host frames to the stage dies)

tp_mesh.note: rank argmax all-gather: 50 b best + tag; 64-b core-side lanes

host.note: host plane: token out a user, prompt / config / KV ingest; stage dies get it in-band via WN0/1 (S81.HOST). 276-b core-side lanes = 331 Gb/s a direction (MODEL; the stage circuits carry 20-30x headroom)

links.draft_fanout: SPEC v1 had 5 draft fan-out SerDes; the rack wires none (RELEASE_RACK 'placeholders'). Not planned: OWNER decision (MTP draft runs on the copy-B wave, TOK.DS.RATE)

latency.note: x fill / return counts 2 edges a tile (registered faces) + the spine stations at 364.5 um

throughput.verdict: ONE TP4 group (4 dies) sustains the saturated AR and MTP head rate (<= 35% busy); the single-user MTP positions arrive >= 23,239 cycles apart > 8,819 occupancy, so a group never holds two positions. 12 dies (3 groups) is the 10-06 rack record: OWNER decision.

routing.note: per-face G0 numbers are recomputed by tools/die_plan/check.py on the generated plan

vocab_over_12_dies.verdict: split the vocabulary over all 12 dies (1/12 each): ~5.6k cycles a position = 0.44% AR, below the 1% adoption rule: NOT a lever

one_reticle_head.note: 1,010 tiles x 0.717 mm2 = 724 mm2 of tiles: one 790-mm2 frame-class die could hold the whole head (no TP4 mesh); recorded, not planned (rack is TP4)

owner: head-die count 12 (3 TP4 groups) vs 4 (1 group): 1 group meets AR + MTP rate (throughput row)
HBM on head dies: none needed (blocks.hbm)
11 dark tile slots (ten = 0) keep the chains regular; alternative: shorter last chain + empty slots (same outline)
